description_en: Queries the settings of two-factor authentication on a bastion host
description_zh: 查询堡垒机实例的双因子认证的配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-instance-two-factor --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetInstanceTwoFactor

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的堡垒机实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的堡垒机实例的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

Config.description_zh: 双因子认证的配置信息

EnableTwoFactor.description_en:
Indicates whether two-factor authentication is enabled. Valid values:

true

false
EnableTwoFactor.description_zh:
是否开启了双因子。取值：

true：是
false：否

SkipTwoFactorTime.description_en:
The duration within which two-factor authentication is not required after a local user passes two-factor authentication. Valid values: `0 to 168`. Unit: hours.

If 0 is returned, a local user must pass two-factor authentication every time the local user logs on to the bastion host
SkipTwoFactorTime.description_zh:
双因子认证成功后，后续登录堡垒机时跳过双因子认证的时间。取值范围为`[0,168]`，单位为小时。

0表示不跳过，即每次登录堡垒机都需要双因子认证

TwoFactorMethods.description_zh: 已配置的双因子认证方式列表

items.description_en:
Indicates one or more methods that are used to send verification codes if two-factor authentication is enabled. Valid values:

sms: text message-based two-factor authentication.

email: email-based two-factor authentication.

dingtalk: DingTalk-based two-factor authentication.

totp: one-time password (OTP) token-based two-factor authentication.

gmusbkey: two-factor authentication by using SM-based USB keys
items.description_zh:
开启双因子认证时验证码的发送方式。取值：

sms：短信
email：邮件
dingtalk 钉钉工作通知
totp：手机OTP令牌
gmusbkey：国密USBKEY

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
